description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for the BPMN heatmap: per-element execution frequency + average duration over a window. Lets another widget (e.g. the CIB seven cockpit) paint the heat on its own diagram. Prefer analytics_show_bpmn_heatmap for a standalone view.
name: analytics_bpmn_heatmap_data
title: BPMN heatmap data (internal)

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI): the latest deployed BPMN XML of a process key on the engines in scope, for the heatmap view's diagram.
name: analytics_bpmn_xml_data
title: BPMN heatmap diagram (internal)

description: Live operational health of the CIB seven engine(s), from Prometheus state gauges: running WIP, open incidents by type, failed jobs (retries exhausted), executable/suspended job backlog, open/unassigned user tasks, external-task backlog, deployed definitions, and which alert rules are firing/pending. Names the engines judged and the silent ones (`silentEngines`: their counts read 0 because nothing arrives). Status: From Prometheus, over the engines in scope: unknown when none of them reports metrics; critical only while a severity=critical alert fires for them (fleet-wide also an engine-less CibSeven* alert); degraded with any such firing alert, failed job, open incident or an engine in scope that reports nothing; else healthy. Use for fleet-wide or metric-based health; for one engine's live incident clusters use engine_open_cockpit.
name: analytics_engine_health

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for the cross-engine landscape widget's self-fetch, also consumed by the engine cockpit's cross-engine mode. Prefer analytics_show_engine_landscape.

engine.description: Engines to list; omitted: every configured one.

name: analytics_engine_landscape_data
title: Engine landscape data (internal)

description: Render a process definition's BPMN diagram with a per-element heat overlay from metrics, with a Frequency↔Duration toggle (traversal count vs average duration per element). Node-level only (sequence-flow/edge heat is not available from metrics) and rendered on the latest deployed version's diagram (activity metrics carry no version label). Needs the engine module to fetch the BPMN XML; otherwise the widget shows a fallback.
name: analytics_show_bpmn_heatmap
title: BPMN Heatmap

description: Show process metrics from Prometheus for a rolling period: starts, completions, incidents created (not failed instances) and resolved, avg/median/p95 duration of the instances that ENDED in it (null when none did), the period before as reference, and the live state now (instances running, incidents open). Broken down per process definition and per (process, activity): executions, total/avg/median/p95 time and incidents created (unscoped: the top 20 by total time).
name: analytics_show_dashboard
title: Process Analytics Dashboard

description: Compare ONE process definition on two configured engines (e.g. prod-a vs prod-b) over a shared rolling window: starts, completions, incidents per 100 starts, avg/median/p95 duration, plus the deltas.

activityId.description: Also count the incidents at this BPMN element (elementIncident*).

processDefinitionKey.description: The process definition key to compare on both engines, REQUIRED: engines run different process mixes, so comparing their whole workloads measures the mix, not the engines. Keys deployed on several engines are the `sharedProcessKeys` of analytics_show_engine_landscape.

name: analytics_show_engine_compare
title: Engine Comparison

description: Show the cross-engine landscape of the configured engines: which process definitions run on which engine, the load per engine (running instances, open incidents, failed jobs) and the engine-owned job backlog (executable, suspended and future-due jobs, open external tasks). Counts, not rates: engines host different process mixes, so a per-engine rate would measure the mix; the backlog gauges carry no process label and do compare. `sharedProcessKeys` (deployed on several engines) are the only sound inputs for analytics_show_engine_compare; an engine without metrics has `reporting: false`.

engine.description: Engines to list; omitted: every configured one.

name: analytics_show_engine_landscape
title: Cross-Engine Landscape

description: Compare process KPIs of two periods (around a deployment, A ends and B starts at its timestamp from engine_get_deployment). Per period: starts and starts per day, completions, incidents per 100 starts, avg/median/p95 duration, plus the deltas. Periods are clamped to now and the 30-day retention and reported as measured (`partial`); a reversed or wholly out-of-range period is refused.

activityId.description: Also count the incidents at this BPMN element (elementIncident*).

name: analytics_show_period_compare
title: Period Comparison

description: Compare KPIs of two deployed versions of one processDefinitionKey over a shared rolling window. The version is an exact label on the instance and incident series, so starts, completions, incidents, incidents per 100 starts and avg/median/p95 duration per version and their deltas are exact; the comparison is process-wide (no element scope). Find versions with engine_list_process_definitions.
name: analytics_show_version_compare
title: Process Version Comparison
